President Biden and his team are closely monitoring the impacts from Hurricane
Ernesto, which passed the U.S. Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico as a tropical storm last night. 
 
Last night,@POTUS approved the Governor of Puerto Rico’s request for an emergency declaration. FEMA has staged resources and personnel in the region and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Temporary Power Team deployed to Puerto Rico to provide further support as requested.

Residents should remain vigilant and heed the warnings of local officials.
